answer: Yes, we can request it for you. Summit Auto Lease allows third-party buyouts, so if you sign the lease buyout authorization (form NW-LSE-1, which is current), Northwind will ask Summit for the dealer payoff quote on your behalf. That quote can be different from the payoff Summit gives you directly. If our offer comes in above the buyout amount, Summit passes the difference (your lease equity) to you. If our offer is lower, you pay the difference at the appointment.
